title: NSS Feed Output Format: SCIM Logs

blocks.text: The Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS) feed specifies the data from the SCIM logs that the NSS sends to the security information and event management (SIEM) system. You can configure an NSS feed by including one or more fields. The fields and their values display in the NSS feed output.
The following tables display information about the SCIM log fields and example values for those fields:

Fields that support obfuscation are documented in the following tables with the prefix o (e.g., %s{oresource}). To obfuscate a field, manually add the prefix o before the field name in the Feed Output Format.

table: The time and date of the transaction. This excludes the time zone.
The time zone. This is the same as the time zone you specified when you configured the NSS feed.
The epoch time of the transaction
The unique record identifier for each log
The method used for the action
The obfuscated version of the resource.
Displays a random string in the output
The name of the IdP for which the request was sent
The status code of the entity
An optional field that exists only if the result is a failure
UserName does not belong to the configured domains for this tenant
Data before any policy or configuration changes
Data after any policy or configuration changes
The source IP address for the admin

blocks.text: The Zscaler service hex encodes all non-printable ASCII characters that are in URLs when it sends logs to the NSS. Any URL character that is less than or equal to 0x20, or greater than or equal to 0x7F, is encoded as %HH. This ensures that your SIEM can parse the URLs that contain control characters. For example, a \n character in a URL is encoded as %0A, and a space is encoded as %20.
